node.title: Re^5: 'do' command is dead? Surely not?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Based on [id://1190638|this post] by the OP it sounds like this is the problem!

Just to add a little info: Unfortunately the 5.24.1 doc is not up on [http://perldoc.perl.org] yet, so [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/blob/HEAD:/pod/perl5241delta.pod|here] is the link to the source. It seems that [doc://do]'s mechanism of searching @INC was impacted by this change - some interesting further reading for the curious is in the P5P threads [http://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl5.porters/2017/02/msg243204.html|The tricky issue of do()] and [http://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl5.porters/2017/03/msg243748.html|[perl #131069] do file: Add './' in additional cases]. Update: So as far as I understand it, the issue might be improved upon in v5.26 when that gets released.
